reply.text: {"say":"Jumps first to build your explosiveness for basketball, then heavy lower-body strength to support it.","title":"Athletic Lower Body","days":[{"name":"Lower Body","exercises":[{"key":"box-jump","sets":3,"reps":3,"repsTo":0,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Land softly, full hip extension at the top"},{"key":"broad-jump","sets":3,"reps":3,"repsTo":0,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Stick each landing before the next rep"},{"key":"barbell-back-squat","sets":4,"reps":5,"repsTo":0,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Brace hard, drive through the whole foot"},{"key":"barbell-romanian-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hinge at the hips, keep the bar close"},{"key":"bulgarian-split-squat","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Control the descent on each leg"},{"key":"standing-calf-raise-machine","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause at the top of each rep"}]}],"unmet":[]}
